### vpc-endpoints-wp-central-endpoints-cost-reason

**Claim.** An interface endpoint costs money for every hour it runs plus data processing, and by default you create one in every VPC that needs the service; hosting the interface endpoints in a centralized VPC lets spoke VPCs use them through a transit gateway.

**Write it as.** `a cost is incurred for every hour` · `host the interface endpoints in a centralized VPC`

**Scope.** centralized interface endpoints.

> "When you provision an interface endpoint, a cost is incurred for every hour the endpoint is running along with data processing charges. By default, you create an interface endpoint in every VPC from which you want to access the AWS service."
> — [Centralized access to VPC private endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/centralized-access-to-vpc-private-endpoints.html)

> "To avoid this, you can host the interface endpoints in a centralized VPC. All the spoke VPCs will use these centralized endpoints via Transit Gateway."
> — [Centralized access to VPC private endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/centralized-access-to-vpc-private-endpoints.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-14.

### vpc-endpoints-wp-central-endpoints-need-own-private-hosted-zone

**Claim.** The AWS-managed private hosted zone for an interface endpoint works only within the VPC that has the endpoint, so for centralized endpoints you turn off the automatic private DNS option, create your own Route 53 private hosted zone with an alias record to the endpoint, and associate it with the other VPCs.

**Write it as.** `managed PHZ won’t work` · `disable the option that automatically creates`

**Scope.** centralized interface endpoints.

> "The managed PHZ only works within the VPC with the interface endpoint. In our setup, when we want spoke VPCs to be able to resolve VPC endpoint DNS hosted in a centralized VPC, the managed PHZ won’t work."
> — [Centralized access to VPC private endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/centralized-access-to-vpc-private-endpoints.html)

> "To overcome this, disable the option that automatically creates the private DNS when an interface endpoint is created. Next, manually create a Route 53 private hosted zone matching the service endpoint name and add an Alias record with the full AWS service endpoint name pointing to the interface endpoint."
> — [Centralized access to VPC private endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/centralized-access-to-vpc-private-endpoints.html)

> "You associate this private hosted zone with other VPCs within the Landing Zone."
> — [Centralized access to VPC private endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/centralized-access-to-vpc-private-endpoints.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-14.

### vpc-endpoints-wp-central-endpoints-policy-tradeoff

**Claim.** A distributed approach with an endpoint per VPC lets you apply least privilege policies on VPC endpoints, while in a centralized approach you manage the policies for all spoke VPC access on a single endpoint; the whitepaper says that with a growing number of VPCs the complexity of maintaining least privilege with a single policy document might grow, and a single policy document results in a larger blast radius.

**Write it as.** `results in larger blast radius` · `least privilege policies on VPC endpoints`

**Scope.** centralized interface endpoints.

> "A distributed VPC endpoint approach that is, an endpoint per VPC allows you to apply least privilege policies on VPC endpoints. In a centralized approach, you will apply and manage policies for all spoke VPC access on a single endpoint. With growing number of VPCs, the complexity of maintaining least privilege with a single policy document might grow. Single policy document also results in larger blast radius."
> — [Centralized access to VPC private endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/centralized-access-to-vpc-private-endpoints.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-14.
